sourceHashEncoding: sha256-text-lf-v1 for .py/.gd (CRLF->LF only); sha256-bytes for binary assets

bake.runReference: 420 advance() ticks at 1/280 s, -0.5 world px (north) each; kept after tick 256
bake.stopReference: same 280 Hz run released at the chosen phase, then advance(1/60, y held, 0) until idle

representativeStop.selection: largest final settle step, then latest last-moving frame, then largest last-moving diff, over all 128 release phases at 60 fps

scope: One NORTH run (128 real advance() phases at the 280 Hz reference) and one representative 60 fps stop (worst final-settle phase). Arbitrary release/re-press uses the same source controller (transition matrix), not extra baked clips. Static endpoint is the produced, UNAPPROVED NORTH idle static pilot (matched to the approved SOUTH v8 palette/scale); it is not creator-approved.
